summary: Open-source AI second-brain cho Obsidian, sử dụng Claude Code để tự động đọc, liên kết và tổ chức notes Markdown thành đồ thị kiến thức kết nối.
usecases: Personal knowledge management with AI-generated links and summaries between notes.
Replacing cloud note-taking services with a self-hosted, privacy-respecting markdown graph.
Assisting research workflow by automatically connecting related concepts across disparate documents.
ideas: Integrate with local LLMs via Ollama for fully offline, private PKM.
Develop a visualizer for the Obsidian knowledge graph that exports to interactive web formats.
Create a plugin that auto-generates meeting notes and action items from recorded discussions.
